name: giuseppe-trisciuoglio-pi-specs-kit
description: A native pi extension that transforms a folder of task files into an autonomous, observable delivery pipeline. It drives a multi-phase execution loop (implementation, review, cleanup, learner, sync) using ephemeral subprocesses with persisted state, spending ceilings, and kill-safe resume capabilities.
